answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 19281 Country: AF Title: Dear Scholar if a person has swore many times and he/she has failed on that one and now repentance on it so how many Kafarah he has to perform for those many swears which taken by name of Allah? Question: Aslamulaikum, Dear Scholar if a person has swore many times and he/she has failed on that one and now repentance on it so how many Kafarah he has to perform for those many swears which taken by name of Allah? Thanks Answer ID: 19281 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 172/172/M=1431) By failing oath if you mean that he could not fulfil the oath and turned hanis (committed what he swore not to do) then kaffarah (expiation) is wajib on him. One kind of kaffarah is to feed ten poor two times to their hearts content, or dress ten poor, and if someone is not able to do so, he can keep fast three days continuously. In the above-mentioned question, what are the words of swearing one spoke many a time? What was his intention? If the nature of all the oaths is different, there would be separate kaffarah for each oath. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
